# Run brief: calm wind in the weather report

## Goal
- `fmt_wind` in `workflows/weather/scripts/run.py` reports the wind as `Calm` when its speed rounds to 0 mph, instead of a compass point and `0 mph`; every other speed is reported as it is now.

## Constraints
- Standard library only.
- UK English, with no em or en dashes and no smart quotes.

## Out of scope
- Every other part of the weather report.

## Acceptance checks
- python -m py_compile workflows/weather/scripts/run.py

## Edit paths
- workflows/weather/scripts/ | Measure: git ls-files workflows/weather/scripts/

## Open questions
None

## Source
- `workflows/weather/scripts/run.py`

definition.catch: The new condition `round(speed_mph) <= 1` also reports a wind that rounds to 1 mph (from 0.5 to under 1.5 mph) as Calm, while the brief asks for Calm only when the speed rounds to 0 mph.
